projects.title: VISTA Wearable
projects.description: The Vista Wearable is a vibro-tactile device designed to help the visually impaired navigate the world. Our device is an arrangement of wearable, wireless vibro-tactile actuators, placed on different parts of the body to convey important information in an intuitive, non-intrusive way. Our technology is inexpensive and has small manufacturing costs; it is designed to be scalable, modular, and comfortable, allowing for easy adaptation to many different environments. The Vista device is not intended to replace vision; instead, it is a tool to help the blind and the visually impaired perceive their surroundings using their skin as the main feedback receptor. We have already designed prototypes of a cost effective, wearable vibro-tactile device using off-the-shelf components embedded in clothing. In addition to helping the blind, our device can also be adapted for use by individuals who experience temporary vision impairment, such as firefighters and search and rescue teams. Our team has also leveraged our neuro-psychological expertise to construct and perform vibro-tactile sensitivity experiments to fine-tune our device's vibration to people's ability to perceive it.
